weapons.name: Static Caster
weapons.desc: Bottled nebula lightning. Two ion damage in one crackling bolt.

weapons.name: Flare Laser
weapons.desc: Burns hot. Starts fires in a third of the rooms it hits.

augments.name: Sensor Baffles
augments.desc: Makes your ship hard to read: +4% evasion and a 20% chance to shrug off ion damage.

sectors.name: The Veil Expanse
sectors.blurb: A nebula so thick the fleet crawls through it. Smugglers, storms and ships that never show up on sensors.
intro: Purple fog in every direction. Your sensors give up almost at once.
The Veil Expanse. Whatever is out there can't see you either. Probably.

events.text: A freighter is lost in the fog, its navigation dead, its captain begging anyone for a tow out.

effect.text: It takes a while, but you get them clear. They pay well, and their pilot decides to stay with you.

choices.text: Sell them a copy of your charts.
Strip the freighter while it's blind.

fail.text: Their escort could see you just fine.

events.text: Shoals of glowing gas creatures swirl around the hull, flashing patterns at your ship.

effect.text: They swirl closer and coat your hull in a shimmering film that scrambles sensors, theirs and everyone else's.

success.text: A collector will pay a fortune for living lights.

fail.text: The bottle cracks and the creatures fry a console on their way out.

effect.text: They follow you for a while, then drift away.

events.text: Static on every channel. Then a ship-shaped hole in the fog shimmers and starts to solidify, right beside you.

effect.text: You hit it before its cloak fully drops.
Your own cloak hides you. The hunter drifts past, confused.

success.text: You lose it in the fog.

events.text: An ion storm rages through the nebula. Your engineer points out that the storm is pure energy, and energy is worth a lot to the right buyer.

choices.text: Harvest the storm with your shields.

success.text: Your shields soak it up and your batteries brim. You sell the surplus at the next beacon.

events.text: A lighthouse station blinks in the fog, guiding ships through the worst of it. The keeper is old and lonely.

effect.text: The finest charts of the nebula you have ever seen.
The keeper tells stories for hours and sends you off with a basket of supplies.
"Retire? At last!" The keeper packs a bag and joins your crew. Their apprentice takes over.
